newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT-Cimento Itau begun as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Cimento Itau begun as buy.

text.p: Paribas/Banco BBA Creditanstalt said it had initiated coverage of Brazilian cement company Cimento Itau with a buy rating.
-- Analyst Peregrine Winfield said in a report Cimento Itau, whose share price has fallen 25 percent since late February, is the most undervalued cement stock in Latin America.
-- "The fundamentals are outstanding and the valuation is now highly attractive against its Latin American cement peers and the Brazilian market," she said in the report.
-- "Its cement assets are trading below replacement cost. Even discounting for uncertainty, we reach a fair value of $408," she added.
-- also said she expects Cimento Itau to grow volumes by 10 percent in 1997 and 1998. "This follows on from an exceptional 16 percent rise in cement sales in 1996."
-- Cimento Itau preferred was up 4.29 percent at 340 reais earlier on the Sao Paulo bolsa.
